Package com.par_28.ship_battle.model

Class Grid

java.lang.Object
com.par_28.ship_battle.model.Grid
public class Grid extends Object
Grid model representing a player's board.

The Grid holds a width x height matrix of Cell and provides operations to place ships and to receive attacks.

Public methods throw InvalidCoordinateException when coordinates given are out of bounds, and ShipPlacementException when a ship cannot be placed.

    • canPlaceShip

      private List<Coordinate> canPlaceShip(Ship ship, Coordinate start, Direction direction)
      Check if a ship can be placed at the given start and direction.

      Returns the list of Coordinates the ship would occupy if placeable, or an empty list if not placeable. The ship cannot overlap or be adjacent to existing ships. And the start coordinate must be valid.

      Parameters:
      ship - ship to place
      start - starting coordinate
      direction - direction to place
      Returns:
      list of Coordinates if placeable, empty list otherwise
      Throws:
      InvalidCoordinateException - when start is invalid

      start - starting coordinate
      direction - direction for placement
      Returns:
      immutable list of coordinates if placement is possible, empty list otherwise

    • placeShip

      public void placeShip(Ship ship, Coordinate start, Direction direction) throws ShipPlacementException, InvalidCoordinateException
      Place a ship on the grid at the given start and direction.

      If placement is successful, the ship's positions and direction are set, and the corresponding cells are updated to reference the ship.

      Parameters:
      ship - ship to place
      start - starting coordinate
      direction - direction to place
      Throws:
      InvalidCoordinateException - when start coordinate is invalid
      ShipPlacementException - when placement is not possible (overlap or out of bounds)
      See Also:
      • canPlaceShip(Ship, Coordinate, Direction)

    • receiveBombAttack

      public AttackResponse receiveBombAttack(Coordinate coord) throws InvalidCoordinateException
      Receive a bomb attack at the given coordinate.

      A bomb attack hits the target cell and all adjacent cells (up to 8 surrounding cells).

      Parameters:
      coord - center coordinate of the bomb
      Returns:
      AttackResponse with primary hit and additional hits in adjacent cells
      Throws:
      InvalidCoordinateException - when coord is outside grid

    • radarScan

      public AttackResponse radarScan(Coordinate coord) throws InvalidCoordinateException
      Perform a radar scan in an area around the given coordinate.

      The radar detects if there are any ships in the target cell and adjacent cells without revealing their exact positions or attacking them.

      Parameters:
      coord - center coordinate of the radar scan
      Returns:
      AttackResponse with radar detection result
      Throws:
      InvalidCoordinateException - when coord is outside grid
